statements.status_notes: Debian tracks CVE-2012-2663 as unfixed with urgency "unimportant" and states that the kernel fix for CVE-2012-6638 makes this issue less relevant. Waiting for an upstream fix to become available.
Debian tracks CVE-2012-2663 as unfixed with urgency "unimportant" and states that the kernel fix for CVE-2012-6638 makes this issue less relevant. Waiting for an upstream fix to become available.

This vulnerability is mitigated by the kernel-level fix for CVE-2012-6638. While the vulnerable code exists in libxt_tcp.c, the kernel prevents exploitation of the SYN+FIN packet matching issue. Debian has marked this "unimportant" due to the kernel mitigation making this userspace issue non-exploitable.
